# Amehnities

> Professional data collection and monitoring platform for public health and developmental projects, built by Amehnities Consulting Group.

Amehnities (formerly ACG Monitor) is a KoboToolbox-style platform for field data collection, geospatial monitoring, case management, microplanning, and decision support — designed for NTD programs, public health surveillance, and developmental work. The platform combines ODK-compliant form logic, offline-first sync, AI-assisted analysis, and FIONET-style dashboards.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Authenticated app shell with dashboards, forms, projects, data, and analytics.
- [Sign in](/auth): Login and sign-up for Amehnities accounts.
- [Install](/install): PWA install instructions for Android, iOS, and desktop.
- [Reset password](/reset-password): Password reset flow.
